description: This file defines dependencies in a FastAPI application, including dependency functions and an endpoint that utilizes these dependencies for extracting query parameters and cookies.

methods.name: query_extractor(q: Union[str, None] = None)
methods.description: A dependency function that extracts a query parameter which can be a string or None.

methods.name: query_or_cookie_extractor( q: str = Depends(query_extractor), last_query: Union[str, None] = Cookie(default=None), )
methods.description: A dependency function that retrieves the query parameter or falls back to a cookie value if query is not provided.

methods.name: read_query(query_or_default: str = Depends(query_or_cookie_extractor))
methods.description: An endpoint function that returns the query or cookie value as JSON.
